Container.Name: SolidCraft-Unraid
Container.Overview: Unofficial SolidCraft integration for Unraid, maintained by denara. The CAD application and browser app are developed by bherbruck and the upstream SolidCraft contributors; denara provides the container packaging, HTTP MCP adapter and Unraid template, not the original CAD application. Linux amd64 only. Experimental software: latest contains the newest container build that passed modelling, persistence and web checks. Server designs and exports persist under /data/files; browser designs are stored separately and do not share MCP sessions. Upstream: https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft. This is not an official upstream distribution.

Config.Name: Web and MCP port
Config.Description: Web at / ; MCP at /mcp. Nginx can proxy both through this port.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Choose your appdata folder, writable by UID 99 / GID 100. Contains mcp-token and files/.

Config.Name: Allowed origins
Config.Description: Replace this example with your hostname. Comma-separated exact browser origins; clients without Origin can authenticate normally.

Config.Name: Maximum CAD sessions
Config.Description: Each session has its own CAD process and model; 1 to 32.

Config.Name: Idle session seconds
Config.Description: Unsaved models are discarded on expiry. Explicitly save designs you want to keep.

Config.Name: Tool timeout seconds
Config.Description: A timed-out CAD process is ended; operations are never automatically retried.
